text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the late sale of the following vessels.
BULKERS - Helen - (built 1978) 42,566 dwt plus Deloris - (built 1978) sold for $7.2 million "en bloc".
Cido Star - (built 1981) 140,086 dwt sold for $13 million incl. three years timecharter at $12,000 daily to Greek buyers.
Mineral Osprey - (built 1990) 28,615 dwt sold for $22.75 million.
TWEENDECKERS - Nadezhda Krupskaya - (built 1976) 11,817 dwt sold for $1.2 million.
River Andoni - (built 1979) 12,000 dwt sold for $1.55 million by judicial sale.
Rose - (built 1983) sold for $2.15 million "as is" to Singaporean buyers.
SOLD FOR DEMOLITION - Ebony - (built 1971) 38,928 dwt sold for $196 delivery India.
Vakis T - (built 1971) 49,114 dwt sold for $197.50 delivery India.
Avion - (built 1971) 60,247 dwt sold for $196 delivery Bangladesh.
